text:
leo burr: Hi folks — I just joined Redwood Inference as an infra SWE (Leo Burr). First day! Excited to meet y'all. Quick Q: where do people usually sit and where's the best coffee?

mikaela: welcome leo!! :tada: we sit mostly on level 4 these days. good coffee is the blue urn by the kitchen. also burrito club on Thursdays at noon if you like tacos/burritos :burrito:

raj: welcome! for badge pickup ping @people-ops, they usually have spare guest badge at desk 1 on 3rd floor.

jordan: hey leo — i'll add you to the infra channel and to the deploy rotation docs. your mentor is ashley — she'll DM you. also there is a quick `ssh jump.redwood` doc in Confluence.

ashley: welcome!! i'll send a 30m intro so we can sync on your first-week tasks. also FYI we do a sticky-note retro every Friday :sparkles:

people-ops-bot: Reminder: New hire checklist for Leo Burr — complete ID verification, sign NDAs, and submit T-shirt size by EOD.

nate: welcome Leo :wave: — if you want a walking tour at lunch i'm free in 20. and yes, we have surprise bagels sometimes on Mondays 🍩

mikaela: also PS — name on Slack is fine but badge will have "Leo Burr" (caps). Ping me if the printer is finicky.

leo burr: thanks everyone!! i'll grab coffee and probably crash the burrito club on Thursday :grin: appreciate the warm welcome.
